user.title: Connect to Lidarr
user.description: Enter the address of your Lidarr instance. The API key is under **Settings → General → Security** in Lidarr.

settings.title: Media source and defaults
settings.description: Pick the Android companion **Media session** sensor or any `media_player` entity (Spotify, Music Assistant, Plex, Sonos, ...), then choose how artists should be added to Lidarr.

data_description.entity_id: The Android companion Media session sensor, or any media_player entity (Spotify, Music Assistant, Plex, Sonos, ...).
data_description.packages: Comma-separated Android packages to read when the source is a companion sensor. Ignored for media_player entities.
data_description.only_when_playing: Ignore sessions that are paused, stopped or idle.
data_description.min_play_seconds: Wait this long and re-check the same artist before adding. 0 adds immediately.
data_description.root_folder: Lidarr root folder for new artists.
data_description.monitor: Which albums of a newly added artist should be monitored.
data_description.search_missing_albums: Also start a search for missing albums right after adding. This can trigger many downloads.
data_description.match_strategy: Exact requires a matching artist name. First trusts Lidarr's search order, which is fuzzier.
data_description.dry_run: Log what would be added without changing Lidarr.
data_description.notify_on_add: Show a persistent notification when an artist is added.
data_description.ignored_artists: One artist per line (or comma-separated) that should never be added.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Lidarr Media Sync
reauth_confirm.description: Lidarr rejected the stored API key. Enter a valid URL and key.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Lidarr. Check the URL and that Home Assistant can reach it.
error.no_root_folder: Lidarr has no root folder. Add one in Lidarr under Settings → Media Management, then try again.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This Lidarr instance and sensor are already configured.
abort.reauth_failed: The config entry no longer exists.

init.title: Lidarr Media Sync options
init.description: Change the watched media source, matching and Lidarr defaults.
